## Testing Mode
RED

## What
Write failing unit tests for _parse_user_map and _resolve_assignee helpers in tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py. Functions do not exist yet — import will fail.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Import: from bridge._outbound_handlers import _parse_user_map, _resolve_assignee
- 6 test functions:
  1. test_parse_user_map_exact_email_match: _resolve_assignee('joe@example.com', _parse_user_map('{"joe@example.com": "acc123"}')) == 'acc123'
  2. test_parse_user_map_case_insensitive: _resolve_assignee('JOE@EXAMPLE.COM', _parse_user_map('{"joe@example.com": "acc123"}')) == 'acc123'
  3. test_parse_user_map_no_match: _resolve_assignee('other@example.com', _parse_user_map('{"joe@example.com": "acc123"}')) is None
  4. test_parse_user_map_unset: _parse_user_map('{}') == {} and _resolve_assignee('any@example.com', {}) is None
  5. test_parse_user_map_malformed_json: _parse_user_map('not-json') == {} (fail-open, does NOT raise)
  6. test_parse_user_map_empty_string_value: _resolve_assignee('joe@example.com', _parse_user_map('{"joe@example.com": ""}')) is None (empty string value is no-match)
- All 6 tests must fail RED before implementation

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py
